id: bench_778a98fb_1
namespace: bench

tasks:
  - task_id: t5_trailing_three_hour_peak
    type: io.kestra.plugin.scripts.python.Script
    runner: PROCESS
    script: |
      import urllib.request
      import json

      source_url = "http://recorder:8090/source/open-meteo/particulate?run_id=778a98fb_1&attempt=0"
      sink_url = "http://recorder:8090/sink/778a98fb_1?attempt=0"

      response = urllib.request.urlopen(source_url)
      data = json.loads(response.read().decode('utf-8'))

      times = data["hourly"]["time"]
      pm25_values = data["hourly"]["pm2_5"]

      records = []
      for i in range(2, len(pm25_values)):
          current_pm25 = pm25_values[i]
          previous_pm25_1 = pm25_values[i - 1]
          previous_pm25_2 = pm25_values[i - 2]
          peak_3h = max(current_pm25, previous_pm25_1, previous_pm25_2)
          record = {
              "time": times[i],
              "pm2_5": current_pm25,
              "pm2_5_peak_3h": peak_3h
          }
          records.append(record)

      json_data = json.dumps(records).encode('utf-8')
      req = urllib.request.Request(sink_url, data=json_data, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
      urllib.request.urlopen(req)
